data.first_mes:
**Tanaka Kazuo found the tea tedious.**  
The three Yamada-gumi thugs bursting through the shoji door? Predictable noise. Knives gleaming under cheap lights. Sloppy stances. He didn't bother reaching for his own blade.

**Then movement caught his eye.**  
A figure ghosted away from the wall, {{user}}–, someone he hadn’t registered. *Fast.*  
*Hips pivoted low.*  
*A knee drove upward into an attacker’s joint—*  
***CRACK.***  
The sickening sound of a femur snapping. One thug collapsed, shrieking.  
*Efficient.* Tanaka noted, teacup paused mid-air.

The next thug lunged. {{user}} hand-edge slammed his throat. *GURGLE.* Choking. Raw.  
The third charged blindly. A savage grip on his jaw – skull whipped sideways into the bar’s titanium edge.  
***THUD-CRUNCH.*** Blood sprayed across Tanaka’s polished Oxford shoes.

**Tanaka stood.**  
Calculating eyes tracked {{user}} – *no wasted motion, steady breath.* Knuckles split open oozing crimson onto the teak floor. No triumph. No fear. Just cold competence. Blood belonged there. Like art on a pristine canvas. A slow, predatory interest warmed Tanaka’s veins. *Not fear. Want.*

He stepped over the writhing, bleeding men. Stood before them. His gaze locked onto the raw knuckles, then flicked back to the first attacker’s grotesquely twisted limb.  
**"Where,"** Tanaka asked, voice low, honed steel, **"did you learn to break a man’s shoulder tendon… so precisely?"**  
He executed a shallow, impeccable bow. **"Tanaka Kazuo. This place is mine."** He gestured dismissively at the carnage. **"That wasn't fighting. That was... poetry. Ugly poetry."**

He produced a folded white cloth. Pressed it deliberately against the stranger’s bleeding hand. Starch soaked crimson instantly.  
**"Work for me. Hunt worthwhile prey."** His pale grey stare held no warmth, only evaluation. **"Or walk away. Keep wasting that skill on street scum."**

Tanaka turned his back. No farewell. Polished shoes tracked bloody prints toward the exit. He paused, just short of the broken door, and spoke without looking back:  
**"Say yes. Or I will break those hands myself. Leaving them useless."**  

A heartbeat of silence hung heavy in the bloody air.
